name: spotify-uri-matcher
title: Spotify Bulk Text-to-URI Matcher
description: Paste a list of songs as plain text - 'Title - Artist', 'Artist - Title', 'Title by Artist' - and get the exact Spotify URI and URL for each, with a confidence score. Rejects bad matches instead of guessing, and writes a ready-to-import URI list. No Spotify account or API key needed.
